flows.title: Check a piece of writing in the Grammarly Editor
steps: Open the Grammarly Editor at app.grammarly.com, where documents can be written and edited in the browser with nothing else installed.
Write or paste the text. Grammarly underlines some critical suggestions as you go.
Click the Grammarly icon on your screen to see every suggestion it has, not only the underlined ones.
Suggestions come in four kinds — correctness, clarity, engagement and delivery. On Grammarly Pro, Plus or Business, grey underlines are your company's style guide.

flows.title: Set your writing preferences
steps: Open the Writing section of your Account Hub at account.grammarly.com/customize.
Add words to your personal dictionary, or remove ones you no longer want it to keep.
Set the language preference: American, British, Indian, Australian or Canadian English.
On Grammarly Pro, Plus, Premium, Business or Education, the suggestions you see can be customised here too.

flows.title: Rework a piece of text where you are typing
steps: Inline Intelligence works in the Superhuman browser extension for Chrome, on editable text anywhere on the web — an email draft, a document, a text field.
Highlight the text. The Superhuman icon appears at the lower-right edge of your selection.
Click the icon to open the Inline Intelligence menu.
Choose Proofread, Rephrase or Shorten, or type your own instruction in the prompt field at the top of the menu.
The result arrives in a rewrite card next to your original, so nothing changes until you have read it and applied it.
